title: Build the interactive infinite canvas foundation
summary: Combining canvas mechanics, design object editing and repository integration in one slice would make performance and interaction failures impossible to isolate. Build a Board workspace with a tested world/screen transform, pan, cursor-anchored zoom, fit selection, grid and bounded rendering using synthetic objects only.
acceptance_criteria: A dedicated Board workspace can be opened from the macOS navigation without replacing existing inspector and review surfaces.
The viewport uses explicit world-to-screen transforms and supports pan, cursor-anchored zoom, zoom limits, reset and fit-all.
A grid and origin remain stable through pan and zoom; viewport state can be restored per Board document.
Rendering and hit testing operate on a visible-object query rather than iterating an unbounded scene blindly.
Keyboard, trackpad and mouse interactions are abstracted into editor intents with accessible toolbar equivalents for core navigation.
Deterministic tests cover transform round trips, zoom anchoring, viewport restoration and visibility queries.
A synthetic 1,000-object fixture remains interactive under the documented initial performance budget.

evidence.note: Current native priorities are inspector and preview fidelity.
Current native surfaces are sidebar, queue, detail and preview inspection.
The current content workspace is the integration point for inspector navigation, not an infinite canvas contract.

blocked_by.reason: Required Board foundation must be solved first.
